name: Homological mirror symmetry and the Fukaya category
summary: Derived categories of coherent sheaves on one manifold are matched with Fukaya categories of Lagrangians on its mirror; the proposal was presented at the 1994 congress.

name: Heegaard Floer and Seiberg-Witten theory
summary: Seiberg-Witten monopole equations gave simpler four-manifold invariants than Donaldson's, and Ozsvath-Szabo later built a Floer theory of Heegaard diagrams.

name: Natural proofs and algebrization barriers
summary: Meta-theorems explained why known techniques fail to separate P and NP.

name: Categorification as programme
summary: Crane-Frenkel proposed categorifying quantum groups; Khovanov-Lauda and Rouquier gave concrete versions.

name: Seiberg-Witten invariants
summary: Witten's physical dual to Donaldson theory gave monopole equations that quickly proved the Thom conjecture.

name: Derived algebraic geometry
summary: Toen-Vezzosi and Lurie combined algebraic geometry with homotopical algebra to build derived schemes.

name: Semidefinite rounding: Goemans-Williamson approximation of MAX-CUT
summary: A semidefinite relaxation followed by random hyperplane rounding gives the best known ratio for MAX-CUT.

name: Algorithmic game theory: complexity of Nash equilibria
summary: Equilibrium computation is classified in the class PPAD and used to analyse markets and auctions.

name: Cobordism hypothesis
summary: Fully extended TQFTs were classified by fully dualizable objects of a symmetric monoidal infinity-category.

name: CAT(0) cube complexes in geometric group theory
summary: Sageev and Haglund-Wise linked cube complexes with group actions, giving linearity and separability results.
